mainText: Good morning. Stock futures are pointing higher ahead of the Fed's two-day meeting, which wraps up Wednesday, and a heavy earnings day. The S and P 500 is up two tenths of a percent, the Dow is up two tenths, and the Nasdaq is up four tenths. The 10 year Treasury yield is 4.98 percent, ticked lower from about 4.99 percent yesterday. In premarket movers, Celestica is up 16 percent after third quarter results beat expectations. JetBlue is up 6.8 percent, rebounding after releasing results a day early. Whirlpool is down 8.9 percent on a third quarter loss and a revenue miss. HSBC is down 6.9 percent after third quarter profit missed expectations, despite a new 1 billion dollar buyback. And Braiin is up 43 percent on a speculative momentum move, with no fresh fundamental catalyst reported.
